scope: Official Finnish sources related to EU, EEA and Swiss free movement; third-country family members; visa and consular routes; administrative procedure, access to information, remedies, oversight, privacy, legal aid and administrative courts. This is a bounded discovery register, not a statement of legal equivalence or complete coverage.
acquisition_rule_status: Thirty-five official external references are accepted with item-specific limits; two Finnish current-law conversions are accepted as dated local copies. Two maintained source locator notes record the Ministry for Foreign Affairs visa guidance and DVV foreigner-registration routes without copying page content; the DVV summary is limited to current linked form instructions because its parent pages returned 403. One obsolete Migri route is dispositioned as already represented and wrong scope. Two oversight sites remain under human review. Unaccepted converted page and text artifacts remain local-only.
previous_findings_carried_forward: The Danish EU-residence regulation remains a functional comparison seed. Finland's Aliens Act is a broad statute containing EU/EEA/Swiss residence rules; similarity of function does not establish equivalent wording, scope or procedure.

Earlier cross-state smoke results named Finlex and Migri but left them provisional because direct inspection was blocked. This review rechecked those leads at official publisher pages and records the remaining access limits.
The expansion taxonomy's gaps in procedure, file access, consular practice, remedies, privacy, legal aid, oversight and courts were searched as separate source classes.
Czechia's stable official PDF fallback and registration/access checks were carried forward as adapter-design lessons only; they do not establish a suitable Finnish retrieval method.
Estonia's documented XML route and future-effective version issue were carried forward as reminders to separate retrieval format from date-specific legal currentness.

N-Lex was used as a discovery route for Finland's national legal database. Its profile describes Finlex; first-party Finlex, Migri, MFA, court and oversight pages remain the responsible sources for verification.

search_coverage.search_outcome: Eight current Finnish statutory pages are accepted as official external references; two Finnish texts are accepted as dated local copies. Three unofficial English translation pages are accepted as language aids with explicit cutoffs; the Finlex portal and N-Lex profile are accepted as discovery references.
search_coverage.coverage_limit: No legal topic is accepted from the inventory alone. The 808/2019 local API conversion still has a date-metadata conflict; its official Finnish and Swedish external pages remain the legal references.

search_coverage.search_outcome: Official Finlex open-data overview and integration quick guide are accepted as technical references. Dated official law pages remain usable without API retrieval or local conversion.
query_terms: Finlex avoin data REST API Akoma Ntoso
search_coverage.coverage_limit: The API returned identity-matching XML for Acts 808/2019, 1050/2018 and 616/2019; current-consolidation API requests for five acts returned 404. Dated official Finlex current-law pages remain usable references without API retrieval or conversion. These local-copy routes are optional; the 808/2019 XML metadata discrepancy remains limited to that retained conversion.

search_coverage.source_class: EU/EEA/Swiss residence, family routes and guidance
search_coverage.search_outcome: MFA visa guidance and current Migri EU-registration, family-member and residence-card pages are accepted as external references. Several direct Migri requests returned 403, but official-domain search identified the current routes. The old family-application route is dispositioned as a wrong-scope Withdrawal Agreement/Brexit page.
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Dynamic agency guidance does not replace the Aliens Act or Directive 2004/38. The old Migri family-application route must not be used for EU-free-movement claims. Family-member definitions, Finnish-citizen cross-border cases and current requirements need legal cross-checking.

search_coverage.search_outcome: The DVV municipality form and linked foreigner-registration page are accepted as external locators only. Direct DVV guidance access was blocked; current page text is not locally accepted.
official_channels: Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV)
query_terms: municipality of residence Finland Nordic citizen
search_coverage.coverage_limit: DVV population-registration forms and municipality-of-residence processes are not substitutes for Migri's EU right-of-residence registration. Some form pages request personal data and are service surfaces, not automation targets.

search_coverage.search_outcome: MFA visa guide and FAQ, Migri 2026 fee and processing-time pages, and the MFA-linked Finlandvisa portal are accepted as external references or locators.
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Fees and processing estimates are dynamic; Migri says estimates update every two months. Country-specific mission channels and prices still need live review. Finlandvisa remains a locator only; do not automate or retain personal application data.

search_coverage.source_class: Administrative procedure, evidence, language and file access
search_coverage.search_outcome: Finlex current-law pages and language-specific references are accepted; two Finnish copies are locally accepted. General Oikeus.fi access guidance is accepted as external-only guidance.
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Finnish statutes are the controlling records. English translations have separate completion and amendment dates; the practical application of general procedure and language rules to immigration-specific decisions needs provision-level review.

search_coverage.source_class: Appeals, administrative courts and case law
search_coverage.search_outcome: Oikeus.fi appeals guidance, Finnish court procedure and structure pages, KHO precedent search, and its publication policy are accepted as external-only references.
query_terms: immigration affairs Supreme Administrative Court precedent
search_coverage.coverage_limit: General appeals guidance does not replace decision-specific appeal instructions. The Supreme Administrative Court selects precedents for publication and provides English translations only for some summaries; no complete immigration-decision corpus or bulk route was established.

search_coverage.source_class: Privacy, data access, oversight and legal aid
search_coverage.search_outcome: Legal-aid e-service guidance and the Parliamentary Ombudsman English complaint brochure are accepted as external references. Chancellor of Justice and Data Protection Ombudsman routes remain open for human review after direct access returned 403.
search_coverage.coverage_limit: Oversight complaints, data-protection remedies and legal-aid eligibility are distinct routes. English service guidance may be incomplete; legal-aid e-services are reported as Finnish/Swedish only.
